name: Ogre Chitterlord — with four Rats when the trigger is fired, no Rat gets +2/+0
notes: Sweep singleton (2026-10-07). "… Then if you control five or more Rats, each Rat you control gets +2/+0 until end of turn" produced nothing: the sentence sits after a token with a quoted ability on the same line, and "Then if" was not read as a condition. _addAbilityPseudo moves it to a line of its own as "If on resolution <condition>, …", tested against the board the trigger was fired on (the tokens the trigger makes are not counted unless they are on the board). Four Rats: nothing changes.
